Team —

We have Jordan Park (applied for SWE-IC) confirmed for a virtual full-loop on Thursday 2026-08-19. Priya asked for a slightly denser schedule to avoid an extra travel day. I sketched a sequencing that keeps cognitive load even and adds short buffer windows for overruns. Please review and flag any conflicts by EOD Tuesday.

High-level goals:
- 4 interview blocks (45 min tech, 30 min system design, 30 min product/behavior, 30 min culture/ops)
- Two 10-minute buffers between blocks (for notes and quick debrief)
- Shadow backup slot in case an interviewer drops (internal float: Hannah)

Proposed wall-clock (PDT):
- Block A — 09:00–09:45 — Deep Algo/Code (Ava)
- Buffer — 09:45–09:55
- Block B — 09:55–10:25 — System Design (Karthik)
- Buffer — 10:25–10:35
- Block C — 10:35–11:05 — Product + Behavioral (Lauren)
- Lunch / Candidate break — 11:05–11:35
- Block D — 11:35–12:05 — Team-fit / Ops (Hannah, backup)

Notes for interviewers:
- Use the shared doc with question buckets (linked below) and record 1–2 quick highlights in the debrief form immediately after the slot.
- If you need more time with Jordan, take the buffer first; do not push the lunch.
- Hannah will join as a shadow between blocks A and B and can be elevated to active if someone drops within 24 hrs.

Attachments: Jordan_Park_Resume.pdf, full-loop-agenda-v2.docx, timezone-conversion-grid.png
Shared prep: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/ACME-REQ-5492
Calendar invites: I will send a single calendar with zoom links and per-block panels; please accept so we can lock rooms.

Thanks Marcus — 2 quick updates from scheduling and candidate side: 
1) Jordan is in EST and prefers not to start before 12:30pm EST (09:30am PDT). They noted a short timezone constraint morning-of due to a family appointment but can do the full day if we start at 09:30 PDT or later.
2) Acme's hiring manager Priya asked if we can shorten the lunch break to 20 mins to free up 11:55–12:15 PDT as an optional follow-up slot for Priya to hop in for closing Qs.

I recommend we nudge Block A to 09:30–10:15, keep buffers 10 mins, and move Block D to 11:45–12:15 with a 20-min lunch at 11:15–11:35. That preserves total interviewer time and gives Priya the optional closing slot.
